feedback_by_option.fil: Kailangan ang sabon at tubig para sa nakikitang dumi.
feedback_by_option.en: Visible dirt calls for soap and water.

feedback_by_option.fil: Kulang ang sabon, pagkuskos sa lahat ng bahagi at pagpapatuyo.
feedback_by_option.en: Soap, all-surface rubbing and drying are missing.

feedback_by_option.fil: Gawin ang buong paghuhugas at tamang pagpapatuyo.
Hayaang matuyo habang kinukumpleto ang handrub sa lahat ng bahagi.
feedback_by_option.en: Let hands dry while completing rubbing across all surfaces.

feedback_by_option.fil: Hindi dapat punasan ang handrub at maaaring makontamina muli.
feedback_by_option.en: Handrub should not be wiped off; hands may be recontaminated.

feedback_by_option.fil: Hindi bahagi ng handrub ang pagbanlaw nito.
feedback_by_option.en: Rinsing is not part of the handrub procedure.
